_meta.description: Pinned USDA FoodData Central records for site macro estimates. One entry per food; per100g is per 100 g edible portion as listed by USDA. gPerCup / gPerEach / edibleFactor document how The Chef converted recipe amounts to grams; the site does not read them.
_meta.source: USDA FoodData Central API, pulled 2026-11-14 by The Chef
_meta.preference: Foundation, then SR Legacy; Branded only where the ingredient is itself a branded product with no generic record (gochujang, mirin, seasoned rice vinegar, chili crisp, chipotles in adobo, French-fried onions).
